{
  "verdict": "sampling",
  "cause": "REPEAT_PENALTY_HIGH",
  "fix": {"action": "change_runtime_flag", "target": "--repeat-penalty", "value": "1.0"},
  "rationale": "The server is launched with --repeat-penalty 1.5, far above the usual 1.0-1.1. That server-wide default penalises every token seen in the last 64 tokens, including the ordinary Python tokens a short program has to reuse. The output shows the expected symptoms: the model writes 'for j from range(6)' because 'in' was just used, it never finishes the nested loop structure, and it drifts into wordy comments to avoid repeating itself, while the template, EOS handling ('stop' after 254 of 350 tokens) and the request shape look normal. Once --repeat-penalty is reset to 1.0, also remove presence_penalty 1.5 from the request, because it adds a second penalty of the same kind."
}
